title: Train Tickets for Day Trips from Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **For anywhere in Brandenburg, the Brandenburg-Berlin-Ticket is the price to beat: 36.50 euros flat for up to 5 people.** One ticket covers Potsdam, Sachsenhausen, the Spreewald, Tropical Islands and even Szczecin, on regional trains plus local buses and trams. Prices checked on 4 September 2026.

**Potsdam and Sachsenhausen are inside the Berlin ABC zone.** A 24 hour ABC ticket is 12.90 euros per person, and the ABC small group day ticket is 37.70 euros for up to 5. For one or two people those beat every special ticket.

**Beyond Brandenburg, the Quer-durchs-Land-Ticket covers regional trains across all of Germany: 51 euros for the first person plus 12 for each extra one.** For groups of 3 or more it usually beats everything else to Dresden or Leipzig.
**The 63 euro Deutschlandticket covers every regional route in this guide but never the ICE, IC or EC.** If you already hold one, most Brandenburg day trips cost you nothing extra.
**The 09:00 rule: on weekdays the Brandenburg-Berlin and Quer-durchs-Land tickets are only valid from 09:00.** On weekends and public holidays they work from the first train of the day.

**For Hamburg, and for Dresden or Leipzig in comfort, book a specific ICE or EC early.** Advance fares start at 6.99 euros each way and climb as the train fills; group and Deutschland tickets are never valid on those trains.
